raw.rationale: FR-180204 is a potent and selective ERK1/2 (MAPK1/3) inhibitor, and in 5-day PRISM viability screens, MAPK-pathway inhibitors typically show selective killing only in BRAF/RAS/MEK-mutant lineages, most notably melanoma (skin) and some colorectal, lung, and thyroid cancers; however, single-agent ERK inhibition is often cytostatic and less broadly cytotoxic than MEK or BRAF inhibitors, so selectivity probabilities remain low and near base rates for most lineages.
